mapper.select: select * from dms_case_history where registration_id = #{registrationId} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into dms_case_history (chief_complaint, history_of_present_illness, history_of_treatment, past_history, allergies, health_checkup, registration_id, start_date, name, gender, age_str, create_time, definite_dise_str_list, patient_id, status, check_result) values (#{chiefComplaint}, #{historyOfPresentIllness}, #{historyOfTreatment}, #{pastHistory}, #{allergies}, #{healthCheckup}, #{registrationId}, #{startDate}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{ageStr}, #{createTime}, #{definiteDiseStrList}, #{patientId}, #{status}, #{checkResult})
